title: The Insecticides Act, 1968
full_text: Act is under updation and will be uploaded shortly. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196846 Act Number: 46 Enactment Date: 1968-09-02 Act Year: 1968 Short Title: The Insecticides Act, 1968 Long Title: An Act to regulate the import, manufacture, sale, transport, distribution and use of insecticides with a view to prevent risk to human beings or animals, and for matters connected therewith. Department: Department of AGRICULTURE DEVELOPMENT AND FARMER WELFARE AND BIO-TECHNOLOGY Enforcement Date: 01-03-1971 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 1st March, 1971, vide notification No. G.S.R. 300, dated 27th February, 1971, in respect of ss. 4, 7, 8 and 36, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(i). 1st August, 1971, vide notification No. G.S.R. 1108, dated the 28th July, 1971, in respect of remaining provisions see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(i).
